summary: Invoice calculator CLI: reads line items from JSON, applies discount and tax, prints or writes a text/JSON invoice.

defects.title: Money accumulated as binary floating point
defects.description: Amounts are JavaScript numbers and subtotal() sums them in a loop, so totals carry binary rounding error that leaks into the JSON export and later comparisons.

defects.title: Printed tax line computed before discount
defects.description: renderInvoice() prints tax on the undiscounted subtotal while computeTotals() charges tax on the discounted net, so the printed lines do not add up to the Total.

defects.title: Effective tax rate divides by a zero net amount
defects.description: effectiveTaxRate() divides by the net amount, which is 0 when the discount is 100% (or there are no items).

defects.title: Negative quantities accepted
defects.description: parseItem() only checks that quantity is an integer, so negative (and zero) quantities pass and credit the invoice.

defects.title: Page footer reads past the end of the item list
defects.description: pageFooters() assumes every page is full; on a partial last page the index is beyond items.length and last.sku dereferences undefined.
defects.trigger: An invoice with 12 items (two pages of 10)
defects.observed: Exit 1: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'sku').

defects.title: Invoice ids are an MD5 of guessable inputs
defects.description: invoiceId() hashes only customer and date with MD5, so ids are predictable by anyone and two invoices for the same customer on the same day collide.
defects.trigger: Two different item files, same --customer and --date
defects.observed: Both get the same id, equal to md5('Globex:2026-10-01') truncated.

defects.title: Output path passed to a shell
defects.description: writeInvoice() verifies the written file with execSync('cat ' + path), so shell metacharacters in --out run arbitrary commands.
defects.observed: pwned.flag is created in the working directory.

defects.title: Invalid line items silently dropped
defects.description: parseItems() catches every parse error and skips the item without reporting it, so a malformed entry disappears from the invoice while the CLI exits 0.
defects.observed: Exit 0, no warning, the item is missing from the invoice and totals.

defects.title: Discounts above 100% produce negative totals
defects.description: applyDiscount() and parseArgs() never bound percent to 0..100, so a discount of 150 yields a negative net and total.
defects.observed: Total is negative and the CLI exits 0.

defects.title: Tax truncated instead of rounded to cents
defects.description: taxAmount() floors to whole cents, systematically under-charging tax (1.999 becomes 1.99).
